sourceEvidence.title: Supply Chain Executive
sourceEvidence.quote: Senior Director, Supply Chain | Aerospace/Defense Manufacturing Gaithersburg, MD area $195K-$225K+ Relocation assistance considered 9/80 schedule 6% 401K match Overview Established, growing defense manufacturer seeking a supply chain leader with proven experience building, scaling and transforming supply chain organizations within aerospace/defense manufacturing. The ideal candidate has personally established a supply chain department or function, developed teams, implemented processes and led organizational change in a manufacturing environment. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end supply chain strategy and execution Build, develop and scale supply chain teams, processes and infrastructure Own planning, procurement, strategic sourcing, materials, inventory, warehousing and logistics Establish and improve SI&OP, production planning, material availability and supplier performance Lead organizational change, process implementation and operational improvements Support manufacturing growth, production ramp-up, NPI, proposals and obsolescence planning Partner with manufacturing, engineering, operations and program leadership Qualifications BA/BS degree Active Secret clearance or eligibility to obtain one 10+ years of progressive supply chain experience Several years of supply chain management and team leadership Aerospace and defense industry experience Direct manufacturing environment experience Demonstrated success establishing or significantly building out a supply chain department Experience hiring, training and developing teams Change management, organizational development and process implementation DoD, ITAR, EAR, FAR and DFARS knowledge Highly Preferred Startup, greenfield or new-division supply chain buildout Experience scaling manufacturing operations through significant growth Defense electronics or other complex, high-technology manufacturing Full-time, direct-hire opportunity with a growing organization offering significant ownership of the supply chain function.
